Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting regulation of carbon dioxide emissions from fossil-fueled power plants.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to mitigating carbon dioxide emissions resultingfrom fossilfueled electrical generation; adding a new section tochapter 70.94 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 80.50 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.94 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: An air pollution control authority or the department may notregulate or prohibit carbon dioxide emissions from fossilfueledthermal power plants or require mitigation of carbon dioxide emissionfrom fossilfueled thermal power plants.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 80.50 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The council may not regulate or prohibit carbon dioxide emissionsfrom fossilfueled thermal power plants or require mitigation of carbondioxide emission from fossilfueled thermal power plants.
